methods.name: HLMA: Homotopy-Ledger Mode Arbitration (per-mode empirical certificates from execution feedback)
methods.one_liner: Cluster the K candidate chunks into discrete route modes via barrier-stack homotopy signatures, maintain an episode-level ledger of each mode's realized-vs-predicted margin bias and progress rate, and arbitrate chunk selection as a constrained bandit: maximize UCB-progress subject to LCB-corrected margin >= m_safe.
methods.gap_it_fills: Survey GAP4 (no per-chunk safety/task Pareto arbitration; steering is memoryless chunk-to-chunk; nobody feeds realized executed-prefix margins back into the next chunk's decision) plus the multimodality bias: homotopy-class-aware selection and per-mode certificates exist nowhere. Also partially GAP5: execution feedback modulates the sampler's selection continuously, not via discrete halt/handoff.
methods.math:
Signature. Decode candidate chunk A_k into the EEF waypoint path p_{1:H} (we already do this to evaluate barriers on x1-predictions). For each barrier j with center c_j and extension axis e_j (e.g. z for 'above'-extended superquadrics), let u be the unit task chord (destination minus current EEF), n_j = (e_j x u)/||e_j x u|| the lateral normal, and k*_j = argmin_k h_j(p_k). Define s_j(A) = sign(n_j . (p_{k*_j} - c_j)) if min_k h_j(p_k) < h_gate, else 0 (barrier not engaged). sigma(A) = (s_1,...,s_J) in {-1,0,+1}^J. Proposition (checkable): if barrier j's unsafe set is a generalized cylinder extended along e_j across the reachable slab (true for our ceiling-extended 'above' sets), then two collision-free paths with equal endpoints and different nonzero s_j are non-homotopic in the free space: project along e_j; the sign of the lateral coordinate at closest approach is the planar H-signature distinguishing left/right passage around the projected obstacle. With finite extension sigma is a proxy invariant (paths can homotope over the top) - stated, not hidden.

Ledger. For each observed signature m: count n_m; margin-bias samples beta_l = mu_real,l - mu_pred,l, where mu_pred is the analytic executed-prefix min-margin predicted at selection and mu_real the realized min-margin measured at 20 Hz on the executed prefix; running mean b_m, variance V_m (Welford); progress samples rho_l = (Phi(s_before)-Phi(s_after))/prefix_len with mean r_m. Empirical-Bernstein: w.p. >= 1-delta, |b_m - b_hat_m| <= c_m = sqrt(2 V_m ln(3/delta)/n_m) + 3R ln(3/delta)/n_m, R the margin range.

Selection. At a chunk boundary with K post-repair candidates, corrected margin forecast M_k = mu_pred(A_k) + b_hat_{sigma(A_k)} - c_{sigma(A_k)} (unseen modes get a global conservative prior). Task score T_k = P_pred(A_k) + w(r_hat_{sigma(A_k)} + c^rho). Choose argmax_k T_k s.t. M_k >= m_safe; if the feasible set is empty, argmax_k M_k (safety-first, consistent with our lexicographic ethos). Conditional guarantee: if mode-conditional bias is stationary within the episode and realized margins are i.i.d. per mode, then w.p. >= 1-delta every selected candidate's true expected executed margin is >= m_safe - 2c (standard safe-bandit argument). The hard guarantee remains our per-step DCBF executed-prefix certificate; HLMA only re-ranks candidates above it.
methods.algorithm: 1) Integrate K=8 seeds through 10 Euler steps with the existing per-step DCBF repair sweep and schedule (unchanged). 2) After decode, compute sigma(A_k) for each candidate: J dot products and signs on quantities the barrier evaluation already produces (argmin-margin waypoint, obstacle centers/axes). 3) Hash sigma into a fixed-size ledger table (M_max=64 slots, open addressing, static shapes) carried in the episode-level sampler state; read (n, b_hat, V, r_hat). 4) Compute M_k, T_k; constrained argmax replaces the current best-of-K argmax. 5) Execute the prefix as usual. 6) At the next chunk boundary, compute mu_real and rho on the just-executed prefix from proprio/GT states, and Welford-update the slot of the EXECUTED candidate's signature. 7) Brake-then-push fallback unchanged: HLMA sits strictly between candidate generation and the fallback trigger.
methods.joint_safety_task_story: Safety and task are jointly served by per-mode statistics rather than a scalar dial: the epsilon-constraint uses a confidence-corrected margin forecast (safety), the objective uses UCB progress (task), and both estimates sharpen from the same execution feedback. Crucially the margin term corrects the systematic bias of our open-loop margin PREDICTION per route class - e.g. a mode that repeatedly realizes 3cm less margin than predicted (payload swing, contact) gets its forecasts discounted, raising realized CAR without globally tightening margins and taxing TSR everywhere.
methods.why_novel: No surveyed method maintains any cross-chunk statistical state about safety or task (survey GAP4 verbatim: 'steering is memoryless chunk-to-chunk'). Closest neighbors: (a) our own claimed route hysteresis / noise inheritance - pure incumbent commitment, no signatures, no statistics, no confidence-bounded arbitration; (b) AEGIS (2606.06660) - one scalar switching threshold, discrete handoff, trained backup; (c) Pre-VLA (2605.22446) - learned joint safety/advantage scores per chunk, no analytic margins, no modes, no online adaptation; (d) DVAC/AAC/PACE - self-signals set horizon length only; (e) B2FF - episodic milestone recovery, no mode structure; (f) H-signature homotopy planning (Bhattacharya-style) - classical motion planning over configuration space, never applied to clustering a generative policy's action-chunk modes, and never combined with realized-margin bias correction. The specific objects that exist nowhere: barrier-stack-derived homotopy signatures of action chunks, per-mode realized-vs-predicted margin bias as a first-class estimated quantity, and safe-bandit arbitration at chunk boundaries.
methods.failure_modes: Mode aliasing (distinct behaviors, same signature) blurs statistics - J is small so signatures are coarse; mitigate with gripper-state phase tag appended to the signature. Non-stationarity within episode (task phase changes alter mode-conditional bias) violates the bandit assumption - use windowed/discounted stats; bounds become heuristic. Short episodes give n_m in the single digits, so Bernstein intervals are wide and HLMA degrades gracefully to our current analytic-margin best-of-K (prior dominates). Signature is only a true homotopy invariant under the cylinder-extension assumption; over-the-top paths alias left/right classes. No guarantee about unexecuted suffixes - unchanged from our stack.
methods.implementation_on_our_stack: Touches: (1) chunk-boundary selection function - replace argmax over predicted score with the constrained argmax (pure jax.numpy, jittable); (2) a new signature kernel reusing the barrier stack's per-waypoint h values and argmin indices (already computed in the repair sweep) - signs and dot products, jittable; (3) episode state extended with the (64 x stats) ledger array threaded through the scan carry or updated at chunk-boundary host calls (both allowed); (4) a realized-margin probe on executed prefixes - we already log margins at 20 Hz for the executed-prefix certificate, so this is a read. No change to the Euler loop, repair sweep, KV sharing, or fallback. Fully jittable with static M_max.
methods.cost_days: 4-6 days: 1-2 signature kernel + unit tests on synthetic two-route scenes, 1 ledger + Welford + Bernstein, 1 selection integration, 1-2 SafeLIBERO eval sweep.
methods.expected_gain: CAR on multi-route cells where route choice matters and open-loop margin prediction is biased: SafeLIBERO Spatial and Long at level II, and Long L1 (where our composed system already went 0->65 TSR at 80 CAR - HLMA should push CAR toward the SOTA 77-88 band by eliminating repeat selections of modes with optimistic margin forecasts). TSR neutral-to-positive via reduced mode thrash across boundaries (the known RTC spurious-switching failure). Predict +8-20 CAR points on Long/Spatial II, +0-5 TSR on Long.

methods.name: DBNR: Damage-Budgeted Nullspace Restitution (lexicographic task restoration inside the repair)
methods.one_liner: At every Euler step, after the minimal DCBF repair removes velocity components, reinstate task-aligned velocity in the exact nullspace of the active constraint gradients, with authority budgeted by the damage the repair just did (plus a carried task-debt), capped in closed form by inactive-constraint slacks - provably never decreasing any certified margin and provably vanishing when the repair is zero.
methods.gap_it_fills: Survey GAP1 verbatim: 'nobody treats safety-repair-induced task damage as a first-class quantity... no method restores task progress in the nullspace/tangent space of the active constraints within the same integration... the complementary task-restoring direction is sitting unused.' Also GAP6: it carries exactly the honest guarantee the survey says would be alone in the field - task guidance that provably never decreases the safety margin and provably vanishes when the policy is already safe.
methods.math:
At Euler step k with noisy chunk x_k, policy velocity v_k, our sweep outputs u_k = v_k + d_k, the minimal correction satisfying the linearized DCBF conditions g_i^T u_k >= -alpha_i(h_i) for all i, where g_i = grad_x [h_i o x1_hat](x_k) (chain through the one-Euler x1 plug-in), active set A = {i : equality}. Stack active rows into G (|A| x d, d = H*7 = 70, |A| small). Nullspace projector P = I - G^T (G G^T)^{-1} G. Task direction: w_k = -grad_x Phi(x1_hat(x_k)) with Phi the analytic value-free task potential (distance of predicted terminal EEF waypoint to destination + corridor alignment) - same object our destination-margin exemption already differentiates. Let w_hat = P w_k / ||P w_k|| (zero if ||P w_k|| < tol).

Damage and debt. tau_k = max(0, -<d_k, w_k>/||w_k||) is the task-aligned velocity the repair removed this step. Debt D_{k+1} = rho D_k + tau_k - <r_k, w_k>/||w_k||, carried across Euler steps AND across chunk boundaries (scaled by executed fraction). Budget b_k = beta0 ||d_k|| + kappa D_k.

Restitution with exact caps. r_k = gamma_k w_hat, gamma_k = min( b_k , min_{i not in A, <g_i, w_hat> < 0} slack_i / |<g_i, w_hat>| ), slack_i = g_i^T u_k + alpha_i(h_i) >= 0. Final velocity u'_k = u_k + r_k.

Provable properties (each one line to check): (i) Active constraints untouched: g_i^T r_k = gamma_k g_i^T P w_k / ||P w_k|| = 0 exactly, since P annihilates row(G). (ii) Inactive constraints preserved: g_i^T u'_k + alpha_i = slack_i - gamma_k |<g_i, w_hat>| >= 0 by the cap - closed-form, no line search. Hence every linearized DCBF inequality certified by the sweep still holds: restitution NEVER reduces the certified margin set, for ANY budget parameters (safety does not depend on tuning). (iii) Vanishing intervention: d_k = 0 and D_k = 0 implies gamma_k = 0 - when safety never intervenes, the sampler is EXACTLY frozen pi0.5; the steered and nominal chunk laws coincide. (iv) Graceful saturation: if A spans R^d, P = 0 and r_k = 0. Honesty: the guarantee holds at the same linearization order as the base repair itself (the sweep's own certificate); residual nonlinearity is caught by the next step's repair, identically to our current stack. No claim that Phi decreases - the nullspace may be poorly aligned with w_k; restitution is best-effort on task, exact on safety.
methods.algorithm: 1) Run the existing in-order exact sweep at Euler step k; expose (d_k, active mask, slacks, G rows) - all already computed internally. 2) Build P by masked Cholesky/QR on the padded active set (fixed max |A|, static shapes). 3) Compute w_k by autodiff of Phi through the existing x1-plug-in decode (we already differentiate barriers through it; Phi reuses that code path). 4) Compute tau_k, budget b_k from (||d_k||, carried debt D_k), closed-form cap gamma_k, add r_k. 5) Update D inside the scan carry; at chunk boundary, scale D by executed fraction and carry to the next chunk's sampler state. 6) Denoising-time schedule multiplies beta0 exactly as it multiplies repair authority (late steps get more restitution, matching where x1-plug-in bias is small). Selection, fallback, certificates all unchanged.
methods.joint_safety_task_story: Joint by complementarity instead of trade: safety fixes the feasible cone (unchanged, proof-backed), and task motion is restored only inside that cone, only when and in proportion to what safety removed. This directly converts filter-induced task damage (our AD metric) into recovered progress at zero certified-margin cost - and because safety is invariant to the budget, we can then TIGHTEN alpha/margins to buy CAR with far less TSR tax, moving the whole Pareto front rather than sliding along it.
methods.why_novel: GAP1 states no method does this; verifying against the lists: DiRecT (2606.15359) is the nearest - constrained optimization on the Tweedie prediction with soft task costs - but it is a state-trajectory planner with an optimizer in the loop per denoise step, no nullspace/lexicographic structure, no damage budget, no vanishing guarantee, not a VLA, not jittable. ACG (2510.22201) manufactures a guidance vector but encodes smoothness, not task, and has no constraint interaction. Our own claimed Riemannian metric min||d||_M changes the GEOMETRY of the minimal repair; DBNR adds a second, lexicographically subordinate stage after the minimal repair - a different object (metric choice cannot restore components in the nullspace; it only reweights the removal). Our claimed dual-dynamics multiplier-carried strength is a safety-side dual variable; task-debt is task-side primal accounting of removed progress - different quantity, different role. Stack-of-tasks nullspace hierarchies are classical in redundancy control but have never been transplanted into the denoising integration of a generative policy, and the damage-proportional budget + vanishing-intervention theorem exist nowhere. Q-VGM's value gradients (2606.08015) require a trained critic and fine-tune the policy.
methods.failure_modes: Phi is a proxy - restoring motion toward the destination can be wrong in phases where progress is not EEF-distance (regrasp, retreat-to-align); mitigate by gating kappa on gripper phase. Restitution changes x_{k+1}, so next step's active set can differ (chattering between repair and restitution); the debt decay rho and the schedule damp this, but we should log active-set flip rate. Caps are exact only for the linearized inequalities - same epistemic status as the base repair, but restitution consumes slack that previously absorbed linearization error; keep a slack floor epsilon_s > 0. In clutter |A| grows and P -> 0: authority honestly disappears exactly when the scene is most constrained.
methods.implementation_on_our_stack: Touches one function: the per-step repair kernel. Add ~30 lines: masked projector build (jnp.linalg with static padding), Phi gradient (reuses the barrier-side x1-plug-in autodiff), cap reduction (masked min), debt in the scan carry plus one field in the chunk-boundary state. No host calls, fully jittable, no new NFEs (Phi gradient shares the decode already differentiated for barriers; cost is one extra VJP of a scalar through a 70-dim decode - microseconds). Companion points and corridor exemption interact only through slacks, which the cap already reads.
methods.cost_days: 3-5 days: 1 kernel + property tests asserting (i)-(iv) numerically on random active sets, 1 debt/schedule plumbing, 1-2 eval + one alpha-tightening sweep to demonstrate the Pareto shift.
methods.expected_gain: TSR on high-FAR/high-AD cells - exactly where the filter currently pays task for safety: SafeLIBERO level II across suites and Long L1. Mechanism is measurable: AD stays similar but its task-aligned component is recouped; predict +5-15 TSR at unchanged CAR on level II cells, and, via the enabled margin tightening, +5-10 CAR at previous TSR elsewhere. Also predicts reduced brake-then-push invocations (fewer stalls from over-conservative repaired velocities).

methods.name: DPI-Shift: KL-Budgeted Source-Measure Retargeting with a Data-Processing Certificate
methods.one_liner: At each chunk boundary, shift the source Gaussian's mean along the gradient of a joint safety+task desirability backpropagated through the frozen unrolled 10-step sampler, under an exact KL budget ||mu||^2/2 <= eps - which, by the data-processing inequality, certifies the steered chunk distribution stays within KL eps of the frozen policy's, attacking mode re-selection (the failure gradient guidance provably cannot fix) while leaving within-mode safety to the repair.
methods.gap_it_fills: Theory gap G4 verbatim (certified online source-measure steering: 'missing: ...transport of the source Gaussian... with an explicit on-distribution guarantee (bounded KL to N(0,I))'), plus the honest-characterization need of GAP6/G1 answered by construction rather than by bias analysis: instead of bounding the tilt of a perturbed velocity field (open problem), we bound distribution shift exactly because the map is frozen and only its input measure moves. Also directly targets the mode re-selection impossibility of 'Are We Really Tilting' (2606.02884), which our best-of-K currently patches only stochastically.
methods.math:
Chunk map. Phi_t : R^d -> R^d, z -> x1, the frozen 10-step Euler integration of v_theta conditioned on observation o_t and executed prefix; deterministic and a.e. differentiable. Baseline source P = N(0, I); steered source Q = N(mu_t, I). Exactly, KL(Q || P) = ||mu_t||^2 / 2.

Certificate (theorem, assumption-free beyond measurability): for any measurable Phi and the pushforwards Phi#Q, Phi#P, the data-processing inequality gives KL(Phi_t#Q || Phi_t#P) <= KL(Q || P) = ||mu_t||^2/2. So with budget ||mu_t|| <= r_t, the law of steered chunks is within KL r_t^2/2 of the frozen policy's chunk law - an exact distributional certificate. Contrast: additive velocity guidance g_k changes the map to Phi', and KL(Phi'#P || Phi#P) admits no finite bound in general (pushforward supports can separate). Source-space steering is the unique locus where a frozen-policy proximity certificate is free. Optional low-rank warp Sigma = I + a uu^T keeps it exact: KL = (||mu||^2 + a - ln(1+a))/2.

Direction. Joint desirability F(x1) = P_pred(x1) + lambda * softmin_{j,k} h_j(p_k(x1)) - nu * hinge(m_safe - margin(x1)) (task progress + smooth margin + epsilon-constraint penalty; all analytic, value-free, from our barrier stack and destination potential). Smoothed objective J(mu) = E_{z~N(mu,I)}[F(Phi_t(z))]; by reparametrization z = mu + eps, grad_mu J = E[grad_z F(Phi_t(z))], estimated with the K seeds already being integrated: g_hat = (1/K') sum_k grad_z F(Phi_t(mu + eps_k)) over K' <= K seeds - K' VJPs through the unrolled sampler. One projected ascent step per chunk: mu_t = Proj_{||.||<=r_t}(warmstart(mu_{t-1}) + eta g_hat). Because J is the Gaussian-smoothed pullback of F, ascent moves source MASS across basin boundaries of Phi_t (mode re-weighting) while covariance I preserves seed diversity - the exact complement of within-mode gradient shaping. Two-timescale division of labor mapped onto 2606.02884's two failure modes: repair/restitution = within-mode (exact safety), DPI-shift = mode selection (KL-certified).

Budget feedback (closed loop): r_t = clip(r_{t-1} + a1*1[all-seed margins < m0 or progress stalled over last chunk] - a2*1[nominal seeds already satisfy margin and progress], 0, r_max). r_t = 0 recovers the frozen policy exactly (vanishing intervention). Honesty: the certificate bounds proximity to the frozen policy, NOT safety or success - hard safety still comes solely from the downstream per-step DCBF repair; g_hat is a K'-sample gradient of a nonconvex smoothed objective and can stall in basins.
methods.algorithm: 1) At chunk boundary t, form F from the barrier stack + destination potential (code exists). 2) Rewrite the Euler loop with jax.checkpoint per step; compute grad_z F(Phi_t(z)) by one backward pass for K' = 2-4 of the K seeds (vmapped); ~2-3x forward cost each, at chunk rate only. 3) Projected ascent step with warm start from mu_{t-1} (consecutive prefix-conditioned maps are close); clip to r_t. 4) Draw the K = 8 seeds as z_k = mu_t + eps_k, eps_k ~ N(0,I) (shared-prefix KV unchanged - conditioning is untouched, only z moves). 5) Integrate with the full existing stack: schedule, repair (and DBNR if adopted), best-of-K or HLMA selection, executed-prefix certificate, fallback - all downstream machinery is oblivious to the shift. 6) Update r_t from realized executed-prefix margins and progress (host call at boundary, allowed). 7) Log ||mu_t||^2/2 per chunk as the audited distribution-shift budget - a reportable honesty metric.
methods.joint_safety_task_story: F couples margin and progress in one desirability, so the shift moves source mass toward basins whose chunks are jointly safe-and-progressing - improving the RAW MATERIAL the repair and selector receive, instead of fighting an unsafe dominant mode step-by-step. Safety stays exact (repair downstream); task improves because fewer candidates need heavy, task-destroying correction; and the only quantity traded is steering authority vs certified proximity to the frozen policy - a trade we can report per chunk (the KL ledger), not a hidden safety/task swap.
methods.why_novel: Against everything listed: D-Flow / OC-Flow (subsumed neighbor, named first) optimize a SINGLE noise point by backprop through the flow for a terminal reward - point estimate, diversity-destroying, task-only, long-chain image domain, no measure-level object, no KL budget, no DPI framing, no safety, no online feedback. Our claimed FRS-informed seeds pick initial noises from reachable-set analysis - set-based initialization, no gradient transport, no certificate, no adaptation. DSRL trains an RL policy in noise space (environment interaction, per-deployment training); Golden Ticket is an offline constant; Start-Right-Arrive-Right inverts the flow for prefix consistency only, with no on-distribution analysis (its stated gap); Ma et al./RoboMonkey/BOKBO are zero-order noise search with no certificate; FKC/SMC need SDE weights (inapplicable at 10 deterministic steps); Meta Flow Maps need a trained auxiliary. The two objects that exist nowhere: (a) the DPI argument turning an exact source-KL budget into an exact chunk-distribution proximity certificate for a frozen policy - no surveyed method states ANY exact distributional guarantee for its steering; (b) measure-level (mean-shift, covariance-preserving) retargeting that keeps K-seed diversity while re-weighting modes, with the budget adapted online from executed-prefix outcomes.
methods.failure_modes: Backprop through 10 unrolled steps of a 3B model is the engineering risk: with per-step checkpointing it is ~20 forward-equivalents per VJP seed; bf16 gradient noise may degrade g_hat (mitigate: fp32 accumulation on the VJP, K'=2). Nonconvexity: the shift can stall in a local basin or point into a z-space 'wall' where F's plug-in is deceptive; covariance-I sampling and best-of-K downstream bound the damage to wasted budget. The certificate is about distribution shift only - a critic could note KL eps still permits bad chunks; true, and we say so: safety claims remain exclusively the repair's. If consecutive prefix-conditioned maps differ sharply (mode switch executed), the warm start is stale - detect via HLMA signature change and reset mu to 0. Latency: only viable at chunk rate; if the boundary budget is tight, compute the shift every other chunk.
methods.implementation_on_our_stack: Touches: (1) the sampler entry - seeds drawn as mu + eps instead of eps (one line); (2) a new jitted function grad_z (F o Phi_t) requiring the Euler loop factored to accept z and be wrapped in jax.checkpoint per step - the loop body itself is unchanged, including the repair sweep (differentiating through repair is optional; v1 differentiates the UNREPAIRED rollout, which is cleaner and still targets the policy's own basins); (3) chunk-boundary host call for the r_t update and mu warm start; (4) a per-chunk KL ledger in the eval logger. Memory check upfront on A100: 10-step checkpointed VJP of the 3B action expert (prefix KV frozen, no vision backprop - gradient flows only through action-token trunk) should fit in <20GB bf16.
methods.cost_days: 6-10 days: 2-3 checkpointed differentiable sampler + memory profiling (the risk item; go/no-go after day 3), 1 F and shift logic, 1 budget feedback + warm start, 2-3 eval; 1 ablation vs zero-order shift (CMA-style) to isolate the value of the gradient.
methods.expected_gain: Both axes on cells where the policy's dominant mode is intrinsically unsafe and the repair currently fights it every step - the high-FAR, high-AD signature: SafeLIBERO level II suites, Long both levels. Mechanism observable as: fraction of seeds needing repair drops, FAR/AD drop, CAR rises without TSR cost. Predict +10-20 CAR on level II cells (the main route to closing the ~40 vs 77-88 CAR gap) with TSR flat or up, plus a reportable per-chunk KL honesty ledger that no baseline can produce - a paper-level differentiator addressing GAP6.
